thread.zh: 只是这几天比赛看下来的观点，发条打类似于蔚梦魇加阿卡丽洛克这种切阵类型中野，只能前面十分钟装模作样压个二三十刀，先锋以后转到边线要投资视野加推中线或者打野靠才能推线。先做推推棒就会感觉既没有伤害也没那么肉，而且发条打刺客一定不点气定神闲那就可能几个qw就打空蓝条。现在发条我个人感觉是陷阱，因为现在都是打野梦魇皇子盲僧蔚琪亚娜，加上刺客中单，中期在边线很疲软，很难推线
thread.en: Just my perspective after watching the games these past few days. Against dive-heavy mid/jungle duos like Vi/Nocturne plus Akali/Sett, Orianna can only pretend to pressure for the first ten minutes by getting a 20-30 CS lead. After the Herald spawns, if she rotates to the side lane, she needs vision investment and jungle support just to push the wave. If you build Hextech Rocketbelt first, you feel like you have neither damage nor tankiness. Plus, you definitely don't take Presence of Mind on Orianna when playing against assassins, so you might drain your mana bar in just a few Q-W combos. Personally, I feel Orianna is a trap right now because everyone is playing Nocturne, Jarvan IV, Lee Sin, Vi, or Qiyana in the jungle, combined with assassin mid laners. She's very weak in side lanes during the mid-game and struggles to push waves.

top.en: 0-CDR Orianna, Orianna feels so painful against assassins in the current patch. If you rush Rod of Ages and need Mercury Treads, you have zero CDR, and then Protobelt only has 10 CDR. Rush Protobelt then blue items, is optimizing into Rod of Ages viable?
